entities.name: St. Elizabeth’s Church Wrocław
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: St. Elizabeth's Church is a Brick Gothic church of the Catholic Third Order of Saint Francis located in Wrocław, Poland. It is Wrocław's second tallest and one of the most recognisable churches which dominates the Old Town panorama.
